name: Odamex
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Odamex, the classic Doom multiplayer port for deathmatch, co-op and CTF. Builds the Odamex server and comes with Freedoom's free game data; your own WADs go in wads/ and your settings in server.cfg.
startup: exec ./odasrv -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -iwad {{IWAD}} -waddir /home/container/wads +set sv_upnp 0 +exec server.cfg +set sv_hostname "{{SERVER_NAME}}" +set sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +set sv_maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +set sv_gametype {{GAME_TYPE}} +set join_password "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" +set rcon_password "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" +set sv_usemasters {{PUBLIC}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Odamex. Odamex publishes no Linux server build, so this builds its server
# from the release's source (checked against GitHub's SHA-256) the way
# Odamex's own Docker image does, then adds Freedoom's free game data,
# checked against Freedoom's checksum list. Your WADs (wads/), server.cfg
# and anything else you add are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build"

tag=$(gh-release tag odamex/odamex "${VERSION:-latest}") ||
    fail "Odamex ${VERSION} doesn't exist. Check Version and reinstall."
version=${tag#v}

if [ -x odasrv ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Odamex $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Odamex $version's source"
    gh-release download odamex/odamex "$tag" "odamex-src-$version.tar.xz" "$build/src.tar.xz" ||
        fail "The download from GitHub failed. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "Installing the build tools"
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    { apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends g++ cmake ninja-build zlib1g-dev libzstd-dev python3; } >"$build/apt.log" 2>&1 ||
        { tail -n 5 "$build/apt.log"; fail "The build tools couldn't be installed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    # Two compile jobs keep the server's build within the install's memory
    # (no swap).
    echo "Building the Odamex server (a few minutes)"
    mkdir -p "$build/src" "$build/b"
    tar -xJf "$build/src.tar.xz" -C "$build/src" --strip-components=1
    # Its bundled libraries build with one job per CPU whatever the build is
    # told; one job keeps protobuf within the install's memory.
    sed -i 's/^ProcessorCount(PARALLEL_PROC_COUNT)/set(PARALLEL_PROC_COUNT 1)/' "$build/src/libraries/CMakeLists.txt"
    (cd "$build/b" && cmake -W no-dev -G Ninja -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D BUILD_CLIENT=0 -D BUILD_LAUNCHER=0 \
        -D BUILD_TESTS=0 -D BUILD_MASTER=0 -D BUILD_SERVER=1 -D CMAKE_C_FLAGS=-w -D CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-w "$build/src" &&
        cmake --build . --parallel 2) >"$build/build.log" 2>&1 ||
        { tail -n 20 "$build/build.log"; fail "Odamex's server didn't build. Reinstall to try again."; }
    [ -x "$build/b/server/odasrv" ] && [ -f "$build/b/server/odamex.wad" ] || fail "Odamex's build made no server."
    mv -f "$build/b/server/odasrv" odasrv
    mv -f "$build/b/server/odamex.wad" odamex.wad
    mkdir -p config-samples
    cp -f "$build/src"/config-samples/*.cfg config-samples/ 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

# Freedoom's game data, free to play and share, for servers without their
# own Doom WADs; your own WADs go in wads/ too.
mkdir -p wads
ftag=$(gh-release tag freedoom/freedoom latest) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
fver=${ftag#v}
if [ -f wads/freedoom2.wad ] && [ -f wads/freedm.wad ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-freedoom 2>/dev/null)" = "$fver" ]; then
    echo "Freedoom $fver is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Freedoom $fver"
    sums=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom/releases/download/$ftag/freedoom-$fver-CHECKSUM") ||
        fail "Freedoom's checksum list couldn't be downloaded. Reinstall to try again."
    for z in "freedoom-$fver.zip" "freedm-$fver.zip"; do
        gh-release download freedoom/freedoom "$ftag" "$z" "$build/$z" || fail "The download of $z failed. Reinstall to try again."
        sum=$(sed -n "s/^SHA256 ($z) = \([0-9a-f]*\)$/\1/p" <<<"$sums")
        [ -n "$sum" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$z" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] ||
            fail "$z didn't match Freedoom's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        unzip -q -o -j "$build/$z" '*.wad' -d "$build/wads"
    done
    mv -f "$build"/wads/*.wad wads/
    echo "$fver" > .raptor-freedoom
fi

[ -f server.cfg ] || cat > server.cfg <<'CFG'
// Odamex server settings, run at every start. The port, name, slots, game
// type, IWAD and passwords come from the server's variables; config-samples/
// has Odamex's ready-made setups (exec one from here).
set sv_motd "Welcome to an Odamex server."
set sv_skill 3
set sv_timelimit 10
CFG
echo "Installed Odamex $version with Freedoom $fver."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Odamex release, such as 12.3.0, or latest for the newest one. Players need the same release. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: IWAD
variables.description: The game data the server runs: freedoom2.wad, freedoom1.wad or freedm.wad (Freedoom, included), or a Doom IWAD you upload to wads/.

variables.name: Game type
variables.description: 0 co-op, 1 deathmatch, 2 team deathmatch, 3 capture the flag, 4 horde.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin commands over rcon. Empty turns rcon off.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: 1 lists the server on Odamex's master servers so players find it; 0 keeps it unlisted.
